items.name: cms-lib
items.title: agent-cms client and helpers
items.description: CmsProvider and useCms (REST client, UI strings in English and Korean), small hooks, shared parts (state badge, copy box, confirm dialog, page header, markdown preview).

items.name: cms-shell
items.title: Admin layout
items.description: Sidebar with collections, API keys and audit log, plus extraNav for your app's own screens. A sheet menu under 768px. Shows "Media" when the app has a media library.

items.name: cms-empty
items.title: Empty collection
items.description: New document, and how to write with an agent instead (CLI one-liner, MCP URL, API key link).

items.name: cms-doc-list
items.title: Document list
items.description: State tabs with counts, category and author filters, search, 7-day views, selection with bulk publish, unpublish, hide, unhide and delete. Cards with long-press selection on phones.

items.name: cms-merge
items.title: Merge after a conflict
items.description: Three-way merge when someone saved first: what merged automatically, and theirs, mine or both for each conflict.

items.name: cms-media-picker
items.title: Media picker
items.description: The dialog that chooses a file from the media library (search, type tabs, folders, upload), the upload logic (straight to the storage, parts for large files, retry of what is missing, browser-made thumbnails) and the tiles and upload panel shared with the media library.

items.name: cms-doc-editor
items.title: Document editor
items.description: Info form generated from the collection schema, markdown with live preview, autosave and restore, problems on the fields, agent change review (accept, revert), save, publish, preview links. Image and file fields and "Insert media" open the media picker when the app has a media library.

items.name: cms-block-editor
items.title: Block editor
items.description: A Notion-style block editor for the document body, on Tiptap 3 / ProseMirror (MIT). The body stays markdown: opening a document never changes it and untouched blocks keep their exact text. Hover handles to drag blocks (beside a block for columns, into toggles and list items, Alt to copy), + and / menus, searchable block menu, box selection, nested lists with Tab, toggles, tables, pictures with captions, markdown shortcuts, a toolbar over selected text, links, paste and drop of images into the media library, text selection across blocks, undo. Pass it as `slots.blockEditor`.

items.name: cms-media
items.title: Media library
items.description: Stores and folders, files as a grid or a list, search and type tabs, a panel with one file's alt text, tags and the documents that use it, uploads with progress, and delete with a look at where the file is used. Needs `createCms({ media })`.

items.name: cms-files
items.title: File manager
items.description: A storage bucket as it is, folder by folder, also files nobody uploaded through the CMS: move, download, share links and delete for several files at once. Needs `createCms({ media })`.

items.name: cms-trash
items.title: Trash
items.description: Deleted documents and files: restore them, or delete them forever (admins). Shown when `createCms({ trash })` keeps deleted things, which is the default (30 days).

items.name: cms-releases
items.title: Releases
items.description: Documents that are published (or unpublished) together: the list of releases and one release with its documents, the version of each, what blocks it, publish now or at a set time.

items.name: cms-preview-comments
items.title: Preview comments
items.description: For your public page when it shows a draft through a preview link made with "Allow comments": the comments on the draft and a box for someone without an account to add one. Needs no provider.

items.name: cms-versions
items.title: Version history
items.description: Versions with author, note and changed fields; compare any two side by side or unified with word highlights; restore or publish a version.

items.name: cms-keys
items.title: API keys
items.description: Keys with scopes, collections, last use and expiry; revoke; create with the secret shown once and MCP and CLI setup to copy.

items.name: cms-webhooks
items.title: Webhooks
items.description: Webhooks with their events and state; a test delivery, the signing secret, the delivery history with send again, edit and delete.

items.name: cms-redirects
items.title: Redirects
items.description: Old addresses and where they send people: made automatically when a published document gets a new address, or by hand to an address or a document (it follows the document's current address). Search, automatic or manual, visits over the last 30 days (sortable), create, edit and delete.

items.name: cms-audit
items.title: Audit log
items.description: Who did what through which channel, filtered by action, who and result.

items.name: cms-command
items.title: Command menu
items.description: Cmd+K or Ctrl+K: find documents (drafts included) across collections and open, publish or start a new one.

items.name: cms-dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: Documents by state, changes per day by people and by agents, the most read documents and the latest activity.

items.name: cms-automations
items.title: Automations
items.description: When this happens, if these hold, do that: the list, the form, a dry test against one document and the run history.

items.name: cms-roles
items.title: Roles
items.description: Roles with what they may do per collection (write, publish, delete, HTML), templates to start from, and the people in them, found by name or email.

items.name: cms-transfer
items.title: Import and export
items.description: Import an export file or markdown files after seeing what each would change; export every document as markdown.

items.name: cms-login
items.title: Sign-in pages
items.description: The CMS's own sign-in pages: passkey, single sign-on, email and password with two-step codes; first admin setup; accepting an invitation; password reset.

items.name: cms-people
items.title: People
items.description: People of the CMS's own sign-in: invite by email, roles, how each person signs in, switching accounts off, the two-step policy.

items.name: cms-account
items.title: My account
items.description: Name, theme and language, passkeys, password, two-step sign-in with recovery codes, and signed-in devices.
